items.text: ETR listed Puka Nacua as GTD/OPTIMISM pregame; confirmed ACTIVE despite calf and played.
items.why: ETR GTD-optimism summary; Schefter/Rapoport official active confirmation.
items.implication: Full or near-full WR1 role expected; no major snap loss.

items.text: ETR GTD/PESSIMISM on Breece Hall (quad); officially inactive after missing practice participation.
items.why: ETR pessimism + Rapoport unlikely then Schefter inactive list.
items.implication: Missed another game; handcuff/backup elevated for snaps/carries.
items.opportunity: Jets RB committee or lead backup full opportunity

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT (ankle); Rapoport downgrade confirmed, close but not this week.
items.why: ETR OUT summary; Rapoport official downgrade.
items.implication: Ravens backup QB; reduced rushing threat, more pass volume to WRs/TEs possible next if returns.
items.opportunity: Zay Flowers/Isaiah Likely/Mark Andrews elevated targets

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT; Eagles activate other TEs.
items.why: ETR OUT; Schefter report on both ruled out for MNF.
items.implication: Major target vacuum; Goedert and remaining WRs/TEs surge in routes/targets.
items.opportunity: Dallas Goedert primary beneficiary + slot/other WRs

items.text: Gibbs almost certainly fine after purposeful slide ankle turn; would have been tilting if serious while correctly not scoring.
items.implication: No major downgrade ROS; maintain RB1 rank.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turned on purposeful slide; watching but Campbell says should be good.
items.implication: Likely fine for next; monitor practice.

items.text: Cam Skattebo hamstring tweak on OT slide/run; watching with bye ahead.
items.implication: Bye helps; expected OK but monitor.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY (questionable but projected in).
items.why: ETR expected; Rapoport Eagles report expected.
items.implication: Lead RB role intact for MNF vs DAL.

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN/activated and expected to play after exempt list.
items.why: ETR IN list; Schefter/Rapoport activation confirmed.
items.implication: Resumes lead RB role for Packers.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value touch thesis: worst runner but RB13 PPR ppg via 9 inside-5 carries + league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: Goal-line + target volume sustaining fantasy despite inefficiency.
items.implication: Sustainable floor/ceiling via opportunity; hold/start confidently.

items.text: Tony Pollard exploded Sunday; sell-high if possible in fantasy.
items.why: Big game spike; Berry recommends capitalizing on value.
items.implication: Trade for more stable asset; not long-term lock.

items.text: Texans routes: Nico Collins 24 lead on 29 dropbacks; Tank Dell only 6 in return (Noel left early turf toe).
items.why: Clear route hierarchy with Dell limited in debut return.
items.implication: Nico remains WR1 alpha; Dell ramp-up slow.

items.text: Xavier Worthy 33 routes on 36 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd game w/o Rice); never topped 83 rec yds in 37 games despite volume.
items.why: Route lead without Rice but historical ceiling cap.
items.implication: Volume there but efficiency/yards ceiling limited; volatile WR3/flex.
items.conflict: High routes vs low historical production

items.text: Think Skattebo is actually hurt (hamstring) but not certain.
items.why: Levitan player-specific read on the tweak.
items.implication: Bye buffers; possible limited next or stash handcuff.
